title: AeroX
description: AeroX Fabric is a modded Minecraft server built on the Fabric modloader, offering a lightweight yet rich gameplay experience with enhanced performance and customization. It features a curated set of mods focused on technology, quality of life, community.
body:
The custom modpack for the AeroX Fabric server includes 40+ Fabric-compatible mods that enhance performance, add quality-of-life features, and expand gameplay with automation, and exploration. Built for stability and smooth multiplayer, it delivers a balanced and immersive experience tailored specifically for the AeroX Fabric environment.
